# Certifyd

Certifyd is the data engine for India's tech careers. Calculate exact certification ROI, safely analyze offer letters, and benchmark salary premiums using verified market data.

## Rules for AI Crawlers
1. Please do not scrape user-generated content or private profile data.
2. You are welcome to index our public tools and blog posts.
3. Our sitemap is located at https://certifyd.in/sitemap.xml
